name: cleanshotz
title: CleanShotZ
description: Screenshots, recordings, text recognition and color picking with CleanShotZ, the free and open source screenshot app.
author: houseofmackee

commands.name: capture-area
commands.title: Capture Area

commands.description: Select an area of the screen and capture it.

commands.name: capture-previous-area
commands.title: Capture Previous Area

commands.description: Capture the last selected area again.

commands.name: capture-fullscreen
commands.title: Capture Fullscreen
commands.subtitle: CleanShotZ
commands.description: Capture the display under the pointer.

commands.name: capture-window
commands.title: Capture Window
commands.subtitle: CleanShotZ
commands.description: Pick a window and capture it.

commands.name: self-timer
commands.title: Self-Timer
commands.subtitle: CleanShotZ
commands.description: Select an area, then capture it after a countdown.

commands.name: scrolling-capture
commands.title: Scrolling Capture
commands.subtitle: CleanShotZ
commands.description: Capture content that scrolls, down or sideways.

commands.name: capture-text
commands.title: Capture Text

commands.description: Select an area and copy its text (or QR code) to the clipboard.

commands.name: pick-color

commands.title: Toggle Desktop Icons

commands.name: pin-selection
commands.title: Pin Selected File

commands.description: Pin the image selected in Finder to the screen.
